brief:
Israel has systematically killed political and military leaders across Iran, Gaza, and Lebanon who possessed the capacity to negotiate an end to regional conflicts, according to Al Jazeera English. The assassinations have removed potential interlocutors at critical moments, eliminating individuals positioned to engage in peace discussions or de-escalation efforts.

The pattern spans multiple theaters of conflict. Targeted figures have included officials and commanders in each territory capable of making decisions about ceasefire terms or political settlement, the outlet reported.
dek: From Iran to Gaza and Lebanon, assassinations have repeatedly removed figures capable of negotiating an end to conflict.
title: Israel assassinates figures who could negotiate peace, analysts say
